message: Hey John, just wanted to let you know that I've been feeling a bit down lately due to my divorce. It's been tough, but I'm trying to keep my spirits up.
John, I've scheduled a meeting for Thursday to discuss the Brand Evolution campaign. Dave has some great ideas!
Reminder: Team lunch this Wednesday at 1 PM. Let's try that new Italian place!
John, can you send me the latest analytics report? I need it for the client meeting tomorrow.
I've been working on the new slogan for the campaign, what do you think of 'Evolving with You - Every Step of the Way'?
John, the client loved the preliminary designs! Great job on leading the team.
Don't forget to submit your weekly timesheets by EOD today.
Morning John, I've uploaded the revised graphics for the campaign to the shared drive.
John, we need to finalize the budget for Q2. Let's set up a time to go over it.
Heads up, the server will be down for maintenance this Saturday from 3 AM to 6 AM.
